inputs.checklistItemText: Existing electric utility facilities (overhead and underground) not shown on plan sheets
inputs.question: Are existing electric utility facilities shown on this sheet? Look for overhead electric lines, power poles, electric manholes, electric meters, or any other existing electric infrastructure symbols or labels.

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence/feature-discovery question: does existing electric utility infrastructure appear anywhere on this sheet? This is a sheet-level feature presence check, not a drawing-element annotation inspection (which would require identifying specific symbols or line styles) or a measurement. The agent is conducting initial discovery before any detailed spatial analysis.
